rules: Board is 11x11 with a maze of walls. The walls are mirrored and you swap sides in alternate matches, so it is fair.
There is exactly one flag. Reach it first to score 1. A new flag appears at least 5 steps from both bots.
Each turn both bots move one step at the same time: N, E, S, W or STAY.
If both want the same cell they take turns winning it (A on even turns, B on odd turns), so nobody is blocked forever.
The match lasts 80 turns. Win enough of 5 fixed matches to clear a league. Replay any match by its seed.
Walls make a straight line fail. A breadth-first search finds the shortest way around them.

leagues.name: Wood
leagues.blurb: The opponent wanders at random. Walk to the flag.

leagues.name: Bronze
leagues.blurb: The opponent heads straight for the flag and gets stuck behind walls. Be smarter: go around.

leagues.name: Silver
leagues.blurb: The opponent finds the shortest path every time. Beat it by waiting in a smart place.

leagues.name: Gold
leagues.blurb: The opponent knows how to share a tie. Outplay it in a denser maze.
